title: Critique: the illusionist owes an account of why it seems like this

statements.text: Neither illusionism nor realism yet has a satisfactory answer to the charge of absurdity. The illusionist needs to explain how having a mind without phenomenal consciousness could be like this, though not at all as it seems, doing more than explaining reactions and judgments, which seems to miss the phenomenon.

sources.quote: For the illusionist, what is needed is an explanation of how having a mind without phenomenal consciousness could be like this, even though it is not at all the way that it seems.
